    Important: This is an awareness tool using clear, local rules—not a guarantee that a website or email is safe. Never enter passwords or OTPs after following an unexpected link.

    What PhishShield looks for

    Good security starts with explaining the signal, not just showing a red warning.

    ⌘

    Deceptive links

    Links that use IP addresses, unusual separators, long paths, or internationalized domains are worth pausing over.

    ◉

    Pressure tactics

    “Urgent,” “verify now,” and “account blocked” language is designed to make people act before thinking.

    ✦

    Safe habits

    Open trusted services from your bookmarks, verify the sender independently, and never share an OTP.
